intro: Every prop below is a pixel-mapped coro display, built, programmed into the show and stored by Master Decker. Tick anything that catches your eye and we'll put together a quote.

groups.title: Singing & animated characters
groups.blurb: Faces and figures that sing along to the music — the crowd favourites at any show.

items.name: Singing Santa & His Sleigh
items.blurb: Santa belts out every song from a sleigh piled with gifts. A natural centrepiece beside the bandstand.

items.name: Singing Santa Face
items.blurb: A giant animated Santa face with moving mouth and eyes that lip-syncs to every track.

items.name: Singing Mrs Claus Face
items.blurb: Pair her with Santa for duets — the two faces can trade verses.

items.name: Snowy the Singing Snowman
items.blurb: A cheerful singing snowman with scarf and top hat. Kids love him.

items.name: Molly the Singing Christmas Tree
items.blurb: A singing tree with expressive eyes and mouth that can carry a whole song solo.

items.name: Impact Characters
items.blurb: A whole cast of bold, high-impact singing characters that light up the entire scene.

items.name: Tiny the Singing Narwhal
items.blurb: An unexpected star — a singing narwhal that gets a laugh every time.

items.name: Jack the Snowball-Throwing Penguin
items.blurb: Animated penguin that winds up and throws a snowball in time with the beat.

items.name: Chip the Waving Penguin
items.blurb: Waves at passing cars and families. A perfect greeter at the entrance.

items.name: Caroling Penguin
items.blurb: A penguin with a red songbook, singing along with the choir numbers.

groups.title: Scene builders
groups.blurb: Big shapes that fill the park and frame the stage.

items.name: North Pole Sign
items.blurb: A snow-capped North Pole post with gold top — a landmark for photos.

items.name: Walking Animated Reindeer
items.blurb: Legs animate so the reindeer walks across the lawn. Line up several for Santa's team.

items.name: Rearing Reindeer
items.blurb: Rears up on its hind legs — great as the lead reindeer in front of the sleigh.

items.name: Grazing Reindeer
items.blurb: Head-down grazing pose that looks natural scattered among the trees.

items.name: Three-Box Gift Stack
items.blurb: A stack of three wrapped presents with animated ribbons and bows.

items.name: Large Gift Box
items.blurb: One oversized present with a bow — stack a few for a pile of gifts under the trees.

items.name: Gingerbread Dad
items.blurb: A friendly gingerbread man with top hat and icing details that chase to the music.

items.name: Gingerbread Mom
items.blurb: Gingerbread Mom with holly — pair with Dad for a gingerbread family.

items.name: Canadian Maple Leaf
items.blurb: A big maple leaf in red and white — a proud Canadian touch for a community show.

groups.title: Snowflakes, stars & spinners
groups.blurb: Spinning and twinkling pieces that add motion and sparkle everywhere.

items.name: 24" Snowflake
items.blurb: A classic pixel snowflake — hang several at different heights for falling-snow effects.

items.name: Dance of the Snowman Snowflake
items.blurb: A 36-inch snowflake with dancing snowmen worked into the design.

items.name: Christmas Wreath Spinner
items.blurb: A 45-inch green wreath with red bow that spins and chases with the music.

items.name: Poinsettia Spinner
items.blurb: A giant red poinsettia that spins and blooms in time with the show.

items.name: Five-Layer Star
items.blurb: A 36-inch star with five rings of pixels for deep, radiating effects — ideal for the peak of the bandstand.

items.name: 22" Star
items.blurb: A smaller star to scatter across the tree line.

items.name: Giant C9 Bulb with Singing Face
items.blurb: An oversized red C9 bulb with a singing face — fun and nostalgic.

items.name: Giant C9 Bulb (Matrix)
items.blurb: A green giant C9 bulb with a full pixel matrix for text and patterns.

items.name: Large Pointed Bauble
items.blurb: A giant pointed ornament with a swirl pattern — hang it like a tree ornament the size of a person.

items.name: Large Round Bauble
items.blurb: A giant round ornament with stripes and swirls that animate.

items.name: Red Candy Cane
items.blurb: A tall striped candy cane — use pairs to frame paths and the stage steps.

items.name: Red Lollipop
items.blurb: A giant swirled lollipop on a stick.

items.name: Red Striped Candy
items.blurb: A wrapped candy with twisted ends and animated stripes.
